verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Tailscale is commonly used to SSH into always-reachable devices (docs-7, comm-1) via a stable mesh network, which implies some resilience, but there is no explicit evidence that an active terminal session survives network changes or device sleep (e.g., no mosh-like session persistence claim). Community reports also note connectivity breakage from ISPs/guest wifi blocking Tailscale ports and NAT traversal failures (comm-11, comm-10), casting doubt on seamless roaming. missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on test of session persistence across network/device changes, confirmation of roaming behavior during sleep/wake cycles.
